description: Buyer purchase & tracking flow + route verification. Rewrite CheckoutPage.tsx to package-based checkout (insert package_orders, initial history row, order_token, WhatsApp, never trust client prices, duplicate-order warning), rewrite TrackSubscriptionPage.tsx with a status-history timeline + Supabase Realtime live updates, rewrite UnlockPage.tsx to redirect to /feature-store, and verify App.tsx routes/imports resolve. Keeps the build GREEN. Depends on FEAT-001 (hooks) and FEAT-002 (store writes the cart this page reads).
steps: Rewrite src/pages/admin/CheckoutPage.tsx: REMOVE import of insertModuleOrder and the multi-module cart loop. Read a single-plan cart from sessionStorage['feature_store_cart'] = { planKey, packageName, category, billingType:'monthly'|'one_time', amount }. If empty -> navigate('/feature-store', {replace:true}). Use usePackages() to resolve the selected plan and its moduleKeys; map moduleKeys to readable names via MODULES (from SubscriptionContext) for the order summary. Layout: order summary (left: package name, category, billing type, price, included module list) + payment form (right: name, email, phone, TRX ID, screenshot upload via FileReader -> data URL) + the existing bank-details box (Meezan Bank, AM Enterprises, 03173712950, IBAN PK36MEZN0001080113741289).

Checkout submit: validate all required fields. NEVER trust the cart amount for the DB insert — re-derive amount from the fetched package (monthlyPrice if billingType==='monthly' else oneTimePrice). Call insertPackageOrder({packageId, packageName, planKey, category, billingType, amount, buyerName, buyerEmail, buyerPhone, txnId, screenshotDataUrl}) from usePackageOrders; it returns { orderToken }. Save a localStorage backup (pizza_king_orders) of the submitted order. Show success with the orderToken and 'Track at /track-my-order'; after 2.5s open https://wa.me/923173712950 with package name, billing type, amount, buyer, TRX ID. Before submit, run a best-effort duplicate check (usePackageOrders/useMyPackageOrders or a direct supabase query) for an existing package_orders row with the same plan_key + buyer_email and status in ('pending','active'); if found, show an inline WARN (do NOT hard-block). Clear the cart after success.

Rewrite src/pages/TrackSubscriptionPage.tsx: public, no auth. Search by order_token OR email (tabs). Query package_orders + package_order_status_history (use useMyPackageOrders or a local supabase query). Results card: order token, package name, category badge, billing type, amount, TRX ID, submitted date, status badge (pending yellow, approved/active green, rejected red, expired gray), admin remarks in a highlighted box, subscription start/end (or 'Lifetime access' for one_time), last updated.

TrackSubscriptionPage timeline: a vertical timeline with stages 1 Order Placed, 2 Payment Submitted, 3 Payment Under Verification, 4 Payment Approved, 5 Package Activation in Progress, 6 Package Activated, plus terminal states Rejected/Cancelled/Activation Failed. Each stage shows an icon (CheckCircle done / Loader2 spinner current / gray circle upcoming) + label + timestamp. Derive the current stage from the order.status and the order.history rows. Add Supabase Realtime subscription on package_orders for the matching email/order_token that re-runs the query on UPDATE so the timeline updates live when the admin approves; cleanup with supabase.removeChannel. Add a Refresh button fallback and a WhatsApp support link https://wa.me/923173712950 shown for rejected/expired. Empty state when no orders.

Rewrite src/pages/UnlockPage.tsx: REMOVE imports of MODULE_PRICES and insertModuleOrder and the entire per-module plan-selection + checkout form. Read ?module= and ?name= from useSearchParams to display the feature name. Show 'This feature is part of our premium plans. Choose a plan to unlock it.' and a 'View Plans & Pricing' Button that navigates('/feature-store').

Verify src/App.tsx: confirm /feature-store, /checkout, /track-my-order, /subscriptions, /unlock routes still import the rewritten default-exported components (FeatureStorePage, CheckoutPage, TrackSubscriptionPage, SubscriptionsPage, UnlockPage) and resolve. Fix any import path that changed. Do not alter the free (unwrapped) routes.
acceptance_criteria: CheckoutPage.tsx reads the single-plan cart from sessionStorage['feature_store_cart', inserts via insertPackageOrder (package_orders + initial 'pending' history row), re-derives amount from usePackages (never the cart amount), shows orderToken, opens WhatsApp after 2.5s, and shows a non-blocking duplicate-order warning; no insertModuleOrder import

TrackSubscriptionPage.tsx searches by order_token OR email, renders the 6-stage timeline derived from status history, subscribes via Supabase Realtime with cleanup, shows admin remarks and 'Lifetime access' for one_time, and has an empty state
UnlockPage.tsx no longer imports MODULE_PRICES/insertModuleOrder and redirects buyers to /feature-store via a 'View Plans & Pricing' button
App.tsx routes for /feature-store, /checkout, /track-my-order, /subscriptions, /unlock resolve with the rewritten default exports; free routes remain unwrapped by LockedRoute
verification: Run `npm run build` from c:\Users\JalipEmpire\Downloads\pizza-king-main — must exit 0 with zero Rollup errors (build stays GREEN).
Run `npm run lint` and fix new lint errors in the changed files.

Run `npm run dev` and manually exercise the full path: a locked module route redirects to /unlock -> 'View Plans & Pricing' -> /feature-store -> choose a plan + billing -> Buy -> /checkout -> submit -> success (orderToken shown) -> /track-my-order (search by the token or email) -> timeline renders and updates live when the admin approves in /subscriptions. Confirm free routes (Dashboard, Orders, Menu, Dine-in, Rider Dashboard/Orders/Profile) load without lock redirects.
